# SD18 deterministic Human Druid level 12 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid
# level-1..level-11 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_druid_level11_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 12 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-11 fixtures, and the
# same canonical nature-bond selection (animal companion), adding only the
# level bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Druid burden surface: no animal
# companion stat block/advancement/link-share-spells, no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, and no
# level-13+ progression. UNLIKE level 11, the PF1 CRB Druid class table's
# level-12 "Special" column is NOT blank — it reads "Wild shape (5/day)"
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) —
# but per the level-4/6/8/10 precedent that frequency rise is bundled with a
# form-list expansion (Huge elemental or Huge plant creature) and a
# functioning-level upgrade (elemental body IV / plant shape III), neither
# of which is separable from the "5/day" numeral without misrepresenting the
# bundled feature as flat, so Wild Shape stays entirely named-but-unproven
# and this fixture makes no new class-feature claim at level 12 either way.
# Base attack bonus genuinely rises to +9 (12 * 3 / 4, up from +8 at level
# 11); both good saves genuinely rise to +8 (12/2+2, up from +7) and poor
# Reflex genuinely rises to +4 (12/3, up from +3); Wild Empathy genuinely
# rises to 13 (12 + Charisma modifier 1); Nature Sense, Woodland Stride,
# Trackless Step, Resist Nature's Lure, Venom Immunity, and the nature-bond
# choice recognition all carry over unchanged — so no new pillar is grounded
# at level 12, only the existing arithmetic pillars are widened (mirroring
# exactly how Barbarian's/Bard's/Cleric's own level-12 widenings were
# grounded).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-druid-level12
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:druid:12
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:12
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:druid_nature_bond:bond:animal_companion
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
